title: MusicDrop TV v1.1.0 — Direct Remote Control & Up Next Shelf
changelog:
• Full D-pad Remote Control: Up, Down, Left, Right, OK/Enter, and Back work on all TV boxes.
• Instant Up Next / Related Videos Drawer: Press DOWN while watching any video in fullscreen to browse related videos and play next immediately.
• Built-in 4K/HD Video & MP3 1-click Download buttons.
• Zero Google login prompts & zero ads.
